data_quality_findings.finding: Non-integer cent precision in share capital amounts
data_quality_findings.details: 15 of the 938 clean companies have non-.00 decimal share capital amounts in BRREG (e.g. 122569.75, 27864258.96, 775057.05 NOK); preserved exactly as float.

data_quality_findings.finding: Grunnkapital foundation with paid_in == amount but empty fulltInnbetalt
data_quality_findings.details: All 14 companies with kapital.innbetalt are foundations (STI, Grunnkapital). For 977539366 (SELVAAGS FOND TIL ALMENNYTTIGE FORMÅL STI), kapital.belop and kapital.innbetalt are both 800000.00, but kapital.fulltInnbetalt is empty in BRREG; emitted with paid_in=800000.0 and fully_paid_in=None without inferring True or False.

data_quality_findings.finding: Aksjekapital companies without registered share count
data_quality_findings.details: 19 of the 938 companies with capital have no share count: 14 are Grunnkapital foundations (STI) where share counts do not apply, and 5 are older AS companies (979346050, 937418906, 861401812, 916070276, 810059672) where BRREG lists Aksjekapital amount without antallAksjer; emitted with share_count=None.

data_quality_findings.finding: Shifted date/number false-positive hazard prevented by row-level CSV-shift guard
data_quality_findings.details: On shifted row 914882036, kapital.innfortDato held '2015-01-29' (a valid ISO date shifted from an earlier column), and on 998600421, kapital.bundet held '30000.00' (belop shifted into bundet). Field-level type validation alone would have accepted those values; the row-level is_csv_quote_shifted guard blocked all 3 rows.

scoring_evaluation.score_impact_note: local score unchanged: the local proxy v3 evaluator does not inspect profile.capital or the top-level share_capital convenience fields.
